title: Some remarks on the Báez-Duarte criterion for the Riemann Hypothesis
abstract: In this paper we are going to describe the results of the computer experiment, which in principle can rule out validity of the Riemann Hypothesis (RH). We use the sequence c k appearing in the Bez-Duarte criterion for the RH and compare two formulas for these numbers. We describe the mechanism of possible violation of the Riemann Hypothesis. Next we calculate c100000 with a thousand digits of accuracy using two different formulas for c k with the aim to disprove the Riemann Hypothesis in the case these two numbers will differ. We found the discrepancy only on the 996 th decimal place (accuracy of 10 -996 ). The computer experiment reported herein can be of interest for developers of Mathematica and PARI/GP.
venue: Computational Methods in Science and Technology
